title: Forecast validation and uncertainty / Tahmin doğrulama
terms: forecast prediction tahmin validation accuracy uncertainty time weekly
body: Use time-ordered rolling-origin evaluation and compare with a naive benchmark. Select on development origins; report untouched holdout error separately. Missing dates and partial boundary periods require explicit treatment. An empirical residual band does not establish future coverage. Never label one minus percentage error as measured accuracy.

title: Scenario analysis / Senaryo ve varsayımlar
terms: scenario price volume budget strategy strateji senaryo fiyat hacim butce karar
body: A what-if calculation describes the consequence of declared assumptions, not their likelihood or an intervention effect. Show baseline, independent price and volume assumptions, gross delta and budget separately. Without margin, returns, capacity, inventory and elasticity data, do not claim profit, ROI, optimal pricing or causal uplift. Validate assumptions with the business owner and a controlled pilot before action.

title: Associations and safe actions / Birliktelik
terms: network graph association copurchase basket product relation ag sepet iliski campaign
body: Co-purchase is observed association within distinct invoices. A strong edge does not establish that promoting a pair increases sales. Use basket evidence to nominate a small controlled experiment; inspect stock, service lines and margin first. Avoid extrapolating a top-products subgraph to all products.

title: Metric grain and business interpretation / Ölçüm sözleşmesi
terms: gross revenue sales quality missing duplicate customer data satis brut veri kalite gelir
body: The current metric is positive invoice-line gross sales in GBP. Returns and cancellations are excluded; duplicates are retained by default. Distinct invoices are orders and are not additive across product groups. Describe source limitations and exclusions. Gross sales alone do not support profit, retention, churn, conversion or causal explanations.
